title: Detecting Anchors’ Opinion in Hinglish News Delivery
reasoning: The paper develops and evaluates a dataset (ODIN) that specifically categorizes news debates into two broad topics: religious and political. The researchers perform token-level analysis and benchmarking on how well their models handle religious keywords and sentiments (e.g., 'hindu', 'muslim', 'Islam', 'secularism') within the context of detecting opinionated speech.
